headline: Cheaper clicks, more of them — Monday profit half again on last Monday
commentary:
- Made **$5,227 NP at 8.74% NM**, up from $3,473 last Monday, though the eight-Monday average sits at $7,963.
- Cheaper clicks did it: Search CPC $13.53 against $14.67, clicks up a fifth to 3,303, spend $44,701.
- The auction eased off — our share 12.8% vs 11.2%, netcredit down 4.7pts, uprova down 8.1pts.
- 3,340 leads is light against the 4,129 Monday norm, but **EPL $17.91 beat the $15.39 eight-week mean**.
- Where the money went: generic $8,709 vs $4,805, competitor $2,982 vs $1,271; payday_alternative and amount both lighter.
- PMAX tripled to $2,902 at a $5.54 CPC and lost $411; Bing made $1,262 on 18.9%.

**Tests**
- Speed is still being walked down off seasonality adjustments onto a deliberately high ROAS target (250% on 27/09): $3,501 vs $5,859, share 14.0%.
- Competitor and personal now run on ROAS targets alone. After the 25/09 target cuts, competitor spent $2,982 vs $1,271; personal $1,908 vs $2,213.
- Scavenger is back on after its weekend pause, hoovering cheap clicks — $741 from 167 clicks at $4.44, share 11.4%. The tCPA twin stayed under 10%.
watch: The midnight hour bought hard — 324 clicks and 21.5% abs top against 8.2% last Monday — and returned $17.89 EPL versus $27.76 across the day.
cle_brand impression share fell to 37.0% from 55.2% on $192 of spend, with lendingtree and albert both up on our name.
PMAX CPC at $5.54 against $2.04 month-to-date, and whether the extra volume covers itself at that price.
